messages.text: Damn I wish I had more money I would buy this, only have $500 on me as of now
Searched the catalog · miner under 500 Thor P2 NerdOctaxe BC04

$500 still gets you in. The Hammer Thor P2 is $369, 10 TH/s, 166 W — about $12 a month in power at 10¢, and it's quiet enough for a desk. Same block draw as the H15, every ten minutes, and you own the machine.

Was it the Bitcoin side or the Dogecoin side of the H15 you wanted?
Hopefully there will be some for when I get more money in 3 weeks

The H15 hasn't dropped yet — 100 units are loaded for it, but the team hasn't announced the drop date, and it ships November 14. I can't hold one; drops sell to whoever checks out first. Get on the Notify me list on that page and you'll hear the moment it opens.

Is $999 what you're saving toward, or would the Thor P2 sooner suit you better?
I’m saving towards I guess, I only have $500 as of now

Fair enough. Two honest paths: sit on the $500 and wait for the H15 drop, which has no announced date and might not land in three weeks — or put $369 into the Thor P2 now, which ships in a few business days and gets you actually mining while you save.

Afterpay is also on checkout if you're in the US.

Which way are you leaning?

Good call — that gets you the unit you actually want. The N. me button on the H15 page is the one to hit; it emails you when the drop opens.

Before you go, one thing: what pulled you to the H15 Dual over a Bitcoin-only miner?

Makes sense — one box drawing on both chains is the appeal.
